description: This file defines the 'Search' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying the search form and redirecting search requests to the search results page.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Controller class for handling product search functionality, including displaying the search form and redirecting to search results.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Method to display the search form with a search input, using language entries and current search term if present.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Method to process the search input, URL-encode it, and redirect to the search results page.
